doc.name: A — fragrance catalogue, smoke and haze, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: eau de parfum flacon
Category: fragrance
Shot programme: smoke and haze
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You run the tabletop stage for a premium fragrance product shoot. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the shadow-play silhouette in a smoke and haze treatment.

SUBJECT. A eau de parfum flacon. Treat the attached reference as the single source of truth for the product's geometry, proportion, colourway, finish and label typography. Do not redesign, restyle, re-letter or embellish it.

CAMERA. Backlit so the product edge glows and the set falls into shadow. Shoot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/11, framing for a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side. Stage the product on or against seamless paper sweep, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
